Report objects returned by the paper flows

Source: R/core-report.R
wgh_report.Rd

Every wgh_flow_*() function returns a wgh_report: a list with tables (named tibbles), figures (named ggplots), models, sample_flow, diagnostics, settings and a note. Methods print a summary, plot a figure by name and export everything at once.

Usage

wgh_report(
  title,
  tables = list(),
  figures = list(),
  models = list(),
  diagnostics = list(),
  sample_flow = NULL,
  settings = list(),
  note = NULL,
  model_status = .status_table()
)

Arguments

title

Report title.

tables, figures, models, diagnostics

Named lists.

sample_flow

A wgh_sample_flow() object or NULL.

settings

List of settings used.

note

Free text shown when printing (for example the simulated data label).

model_status

A tibble with step, status ("ok", "failed" or "skipped") and message. Inside a flow it is filled automatically, so a failed or skipped optional analysis is visible rather than silently missing from the tables.

Value

An object of class wgh_report.

Next steps

Print the report to see what it holds, take tables with x$tables$name, show figures with plot.wgh_report(), check x$model_status, and write everything to disk with wgh_export().

Examples

tab <- data.frame(sex = c("Male", "Female"), n = c(10, 12))
r <- wgh_report("A small report", tables = list(n = tab))
r
#> 
#> ── A small report ──
#> 
#> Tables (1): n
#> Figures (0):
#> Settings:
r$tables$n
#>      sex  n
#> 1   Male 10
#> 2 Female 12
